program.name: Middle Split
program.subject: Flexibility
program.blurb: Toward the middle split and pancake: straddle and groin, then hips and hamstrings.
program.about: Working toward the middle split. One day holds straddles, frog and butterfly shapes for the groin; the other the hips and hamstrings that hold the split back. Both end on a straddle or pancake. They alternate. Both later levels hold every stretch longer.
